lines: 001 · Forking Yours Wallet onto phones: how bWalletX started, and why we left the Yours code alone.
002 · Four names in a week: Yours Wallet Mobile, bCorp Wallet, bWallet, then bWalletX. Why the name kept changing, and why there are now two apps.
003 · Tabs, apps and a social feed: The phone layout changed many times. We added an Apps home screen with 100+ BSV apps, a Media player and a feed that reads other BSV social apps.
004 · Names, handles and paymail: Send to $handle, name@bwalletx.com or an OpNS name. The paymail server moved domain twice, and social sign-in became a verified name.
005 · Personal tokens and token rooms: Hold a token to enter its chat room. Your $NAME is a token with its own room. How rooms, tickets and issuers came together, and what we reversed.
006 · Who pays for indexing: A BSV-21 token only shows up in wallets once an indexer lists it. Working out who pays for that, and how much, took four attempts.
007 · Store rules, open rooms and moderation: We audited the app against App Store and Play rules, split it into four release channels and built the safety features the stores require.
008 · Building the Exchange, and why buys broke: Listing and buying 1Sat tokens from the wallet. Most of the work was not the screens but storage limits, double-encrypted records and slow APIs.
009 · The b agent: paid, or your own key: An assistant inside the wallet. It started free, became paid-only within a day, and now asks for consent before it sends anything.
010 · Agent accounts, strategies, CLI and MCP: Separate wallet accounts for agents, spending rules the wallet enforces, a market for strategies, and a command-line tool that keeps keys on the phone.

011 · From a dollar bond to PNEEs on mainnet: A BSV-backed dollar token went from a design note to a small, capped mainnet pilot in two days. This is what is enforced, what is not, and what went wrong.

012 · The extension, the web app and pairing: bWalletX also runs as a Chrome and Brave extension and as a web app. On iPhone the web app is the only way to get the full wallet, so we made backup mandatory there.
013 · Two sites from one: A download page became bwallet.space, then bwalletx.com became the main site, with the store site generated from it. And this blog.
